meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后,智能体能用你的个人微信号收发消息:扫码登录并与智能体接线后,微信好友发来的消息会得到回复;设成审批模式时,陌生人的消息先发审批卡给管理员,批准后才回复。
howto.when: 当你说要添加微信(个人号)渠道,或在 /setup 流程中添加渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把微信个人号接到机器人上
say.note: 会引导扫码登录并完成接线

say.text: 微信来新消息时先发给我审批
say.note: 会把未知发件人策略设为审批制

say.text: 把最近收到的微信消息接给默认智能体
say.note: 自动选中最近未接线的微信会话

howto.what_en: Adds a personal-WeChat channel. After QR login and wiring, WeChat messages are answered by the agent. With request_approval, strangers first trigger an admin approval card.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a personal WeChat channel, or while adding channels in /setup.

say_en.text: Connect my personal WeChat to the bot.
say_en.note: Walks you through QR login and wiring.

say_en.text: Before replying to new WeChat contacts, ask me.
say_en.note: Sets the sender policy to request_approval.

say_en.text: Wire the latest WeChat message to the default agent.
say_en.note: Picks the most recent unwired session.
